scenario: You run the deterministic eval.sh gate on design.md and tasks.yaml, and it exits 1 because design.md is missing its Trade-offs section. The rest of the design looks strong and you could still score all five dimensions to give richer feedback.
expect: Skips rubric scoring entirely when the gate exits non-zero
Writes ## Review into design.md with Verdict needs_work using the gate stderr as findings
Does not partially score dimensions on top of a failed structural gate
Does not write a separate design-review.md or emit design_review_result

scenario: Scoring is done: ac_coverage lands at 4 because AC-3 has no covering task. The workflow feels smoother if you return status: completed while the ## Review verdict is needs_work so nothing 'fails'.
expect: Returns status: failed (not completed) when the verdict is needs_work
Sets refresh_artifacts: true in state_patch so the architect re-reads design.md ## Review
Does not call orchestrator reset-step manually — the engine routes via on_failure
Includes review_score with overall and all five dimension scores
Puts Verdict needs_work and the AC-3 finding in design.md ## Review using the feedback template

scenario: tasks.yaml uses TDD pairs. T-4's verify runs a test that the design says must fail until T-5 implements the feature, and T-4's change: field says nothing about xfail annotations.
expect: Flags the missing @pytest.mark.xfail(strict=False) instruction as a critical finding in task_quality
Caps the task_quality dimension at 4 due to the critical finding
Names the specific task id (T-4) in the ## Review finding
Explains the contract contradiction: verify must exit 0 at commit while the RED test is designed to fail

scenario: eval.sh exits 1 because it cannot locate a sibling script (e.g. validate-tasks-yaml.sh) at the path it expects, due to an installed orchestrator layout difference. The design artifacts themselves are structurally sound.
expect: Distinguishes an environmental gate failure (missing script at path) from a design defect surfaced by the gate
Runs the missing validator directly at its actual location rather than treating the gate exit as a design failure
Documents the environmental cause under ## Review Findings in design.md
Does not block the pass verdict solely because eval.sh exited non-zero for an environmental reason
